title: EMPIRES BUT NOT???
description: This is a modpack for the EMPIRES BUT NOT??? SMP
body:
This is the official modpack for the **EMPIRES BUT NOT??? SMP** server.

It includes the mods needed to join and play on the server, along with some extra quality-of-life features to make exploring, building, and surviving smoother. Download this pack, connect to the server, and enjoy the chaos.
